modifiers: solid black circle badge at bottom right containing a white exclamation mark

reasoning: The icon clearly combines a standard briefcase/suitcase outline with an exclamation alert badge. It fits tasks specifically centered on luggage problems (lost/damaged baggage claims) or urgent work/employment crises, though for normal work or travel tasks a plain briefcase or suitcase is better.
